items.t: AppLovin Just Gained 45% in a Month. What Will It Take to Hit $500?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysAppLovin (APP:NASDAQ) stock is up 45% in the past month on 55% Q3 revenue growth and a Q4 guide above estimates. Gaming grew nearly 50%, so Roblox’s (RBLX:NYSE) user slump looks like its own problem, though Unity Software’s (U:NYSE) ad engine is growing even faster.

items.t: StoneX Maintains Buy on AppLovin, Raises Price Target to $469
items.sum: StoneX analyst Mike Hickey maintains AppLovin (NASDAQ:APP) with a Buy and raises the price target from $440 to $469.

items.t: AppLovin: AXON Upgrades Reignite Growth, But Competitive Risks Remain

items.t: Here’s How Much You Would Have Made Owning AppLovin Stock In The Last 15 Years
items.sum: AppLovin (NASDAQ:APP) has outperformed the market over the past 15 years by 8.0% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 21.03%. Currently, AppLovin has a market capitalization of $132.18 billion.
